# xfo-miner v1.0.14

This release improves CPU mining resilience by adding automatic XMRig stratum port switching when the miner appears to sit on an unsuitable pool difficulty/port profile.

## Highlights

- Adds built-in XMRig port auto-switching across the standard 3333/5555/7777 pool ports derived from the configured pool host.
- Keeps port/difficulty policy internal so operators do not need to configure `port_auto_switch` or tune diff thresholds manually.
- Uses XMRig share log observations to detect accepted shares near a port's high-diff cap or low-diff floor, then restarts XMRig on a more suitable port.
- Probes the target stratum endpoint before switching to avoid moving a live miner to an unreachable port.

## Scope

### CPU mining port adaptation

- `internal/scheduler/xmrig.go` parses accepted/rejected share summaries and share difficulty from XMRig logs.
- `internal/scheduler/xmrig.go` derives fixed 3333/5555/7777 stratum URLs from the configured `cpu_mining.stratum_url` host.
- `internal/scheduler/xmrig.go` applies an internal decision window, cooldown, diff thresholds, and reject-rate fallback before restarting XMRig on the selected port.
- `config.example.json` intentionally continues to expose only the normal `cpu_mining.stratum_url`; the automatic policy is not user-facing configuration.

## Validation

- Release validation:
  - `gofmt -w cmd/xfo-miner/main.go internal/config/config.go internal/config/config_test.go internal/scheduler/xmrig.go internal/scheduler/xmrig_test.go internal/scheduler/scheduler_test.go`
  - `go test ./...`
  - `python3 -m json.tool config.example.json`
  - `git diff --check`
- `miner-ci` on push runs `go test ./...` and cross-builds Linux amd64/arm64, Windows amd64, and macOS amd64/arm64.
- `miner-release` on tag builds deterministic release packages, uploads `latest.json`, validates the public release surface, and publishes GitHub release assets.

## Operator notes

- Existing configs do not need to change; keep using the normal 3333 stratum URL in `cpu_mining.stratum_url`.
- The miner may restart XMRig once when it detects that another standard pool port better matches observed share difficulty.
- Automatic switching only affects the CPU/XMRig path and does not change L2/GPU mining behavior.
